report: The complete claim prohibits repeated type-parameter names within a value declaration. Rechecked the prior rationale and verified exact equality of current validate.rs and language.rs to their historical snapshots. The sole ordinary implementation in Model::check_values creates a fresh BTreeSet per declaration and checks every parameter insertion, emitting duplicate type parameter NAME on any repetition; it runs before the opaque/struct/enum shape dispatch, covers nonadjacent and subsequent repetitions, and does not combine different declarations. build_model collects all value declarations and Model::check invokes check_values and returns its errors. The sole ordinary associated test checks_arity_scope_and_duplicate_members_in_value_types supplies Bad<T,T> and visibly asserts the duplicate type parameter T diagnostic among other diagnostics, so removing the duplicate check would fail its assertion. The captured check helper parses the supplied model and invokes validate, rather than manufacturing diagnostics. This integration assertion and the common shape-independent implementation adequately cover the claim; there are no TODO/N/A entries or additional qualifications. Inspected source and ran review start/read plus historical byte comparisons; no behavior tests or builds were independently executed in this review. The coordinator reports the separate successful test suite and build. No edits required.
